description: A phase modulation oscillator: one modulator driving a second modulator driving the carrier, with a low pass on the modulation

params.text: Sets the carrier pitch, four octaves either side of C4 at 261.63Hz
Sets the low pass on the modulation before it reaches the carrier, four octaves either side of the carrier pitch
Sets the first modulator's pitch against the carrier, a whole number of semitones from -12 to 12
Sets the second modulator's pitch against the carrier, a whole number of semitones from -12 to 12
Sets how far the first modulator moves the carrier's phase, 0 to 100 per cent
Sets how far the second modulator moves the first modulator's phase, 0 to 100 per cent

inputs.text: Moves the carrier pitch one octave per volt on top of the FRQ knob
Moves the modulation filter one octave per volt on top of the LPF knob
Moves the first modulator's pitch one octave per volt on top of its ratio knob
Moves the second modulator's pitch one octave per volt on top of its ratio knob
Adds to the first modulator's depth, ten per cent per volt
Adds to the second modulator's depth, ten per cent per volt

outputs.text: The carrier as a triangle bent by the modulation, -5V to 5V, despite the maker's tooltip on this jack reading Modulation
The filtered modulation that drives the carrier, -5V to 5V, despite the maker's tooltip on this jack reading Audio

notes: the ratio knobs step in semitones while the ratio inputs are an octave per volt, so a two to one ratio is 12 on the knob and 1V at the jack
